name: Khatta Meetha
ingredients_raw: Edible Vegetable Oil (Palmolein, Cotton Seed, Corn, Sunflower, Rice Bran), Rice Flakes (22%), Bengal Gram Flour (Besan) (21%), Refined Sugar, Split Pulse Bengal Gram (Chana Dal) (7%), Groundnuts (Peanuts) (5%), Sago (4%), Red Lentils (Masur Whole) (2.5%), Tapioca Starch, lodised Salt, Black Salt, Turmeric, Acidity Regulator (INS 330), Red Chilli, Ajwain, Raising Agent (INS 500 ii) & Asafoetida. Allergen: Contains Nut May Contains Wheat, Milk & Soy. 29
